name: synthetic-chinese-blog-retrieval
source: Repository-authored Chinese technical documents and manually labelled relevance/evidence; no production export
scope: Public capability and ranking regression only; not a production quality score, blind holdout or public benchmark leaderboard. dev includes previously exercised cases and alias examples; test is separately authored and frozen before this implementation is evaluated.
